ask: Set Cloudflare records for seatwise, hq and the wildcard to DNS only, or turn off Web Analytics auto setup and bot JavaScript detections
why: Cloudflare adds its own scripts to every page. Seatwise blocks them for safety, which shows 3 errors per page, so it fails its launch check. It also goes against your rule of no proxies.
ifNo: Seatwise, and every product after it, cannot launch.
title: Turn off Cloudflare's proxy for your subdomains
youDo: In Cloudflare, open DNS for anchit-tandon.com and switch the records for seatwise, hq and * (the wildcard) from Proxied (orange cloud) to DNS only (grey cloud). About 2 minutes. Then comment approve.
